replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
You can make a void map by selecting flatland when creating a world in single player by changing the layers.

I also suggest you install some mods/plugins (depends if you are on single player or on localhost) like World Edit to help you.

After you have a void map ready and all the plugins/mods to work with just build your map. When you are done go into MCEdit to prune your map so there is no unneeded chunks, and then package your map with the YML file. For more assistance on that you can visit docs.avicus.net

And capitalising every word is quite annoying. Even if thats how "you write on the forums" some people might not bother to read and assist you if you write like that.

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Singleplayer: If you wish to make a void world on singleplayer, I find the easiest way to do so it download a void world such as this one http://www.mediafire.com/download/9e2z3e464oie7a5/Infinite+Void+Map.zip
If you choose to make your map on singleplayer download something like Single Player Commands (http://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding/minecraft-mods/1272348-single-player-comman...) To aid you in building. Trust me it'll help a lot!

Multiplayer: As for multiplayer, there are various build servers existing. If would ever need one, contact me on Skype (thehoopsman)
